title: Vanishing cone density happens only on an Hⁿ-null set (Mattila 15.15–15.16; Dall'Alba Cor. 4.7, Lemma 5.2)
statement: Let n ≥ 1, ℓ ∈ ℕ, N := n + ℓ, W ⊆ ℝ^N an n-dimensional subspace, P := W.starProjection, X(a, r, s) := {x : |P(x − a)| < s|x − a|} ∩ B(a, r), A ⊆ ℝ^N purely n-unrectifiable and δ > 0. Then the set of a ∈ A such that for every c > 0 there is ε > 0 with Hⁿ(A ∩ X(a, r, s)) ≤ c(rs)ⁿ for all 0 < s < ε and 0 < r < δ (i.e. the cone density Φ_δ(a, W^⊥) = limsup_{s↓0} sup_{0<r<δ}(rs)^{−n}Hⁿ(A ∩ X(a, r, s)) vanishes) has Hⁿ-measure 0.
lean_statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → ∀ (W : Submodule ℝ (Rn (n + ℓ))), finrank ℝ W = n → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), PurelyUnrectifiable n A → ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → μHE[n] {a | a ∈ A ∧ ∀ c : ℝ, 0 < c → ∃ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε ∧ ∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s < ε → ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → r < δ → μHE[n] (A ∩ ({x | ‖W.starProjection (x - a)‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} ∩ Metric.ball a r)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (r * s) ^ n)} = 0
